== Biography ==
Deliverance was born in 1814. 

Deliverance Hanna Glasgow is named as the daughter of the late James Glasgow, a minor at James Sr.'s death, in an 1837 court notice in the Baltimore Gazette & Daily Advertiser.<ref>Baltimore Gazette & Daily Advertiser, Friday, 23 June 1837,  Volume 87, Issue 14465, Page 4, Column 5. Image found on {{FindAGrave|105585399|sameas="no"}}</ref> 

She passed away in 1890. <ref> Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/31955882/deliverance-h-lee : accessed 25 December 2021), memorial page for Deliverance H Glasgow Lee (7 Jul 1814–10 Apr 1890), Find a Grave Memorial ID 31955882, citing Churchville Presbyterian Church Cemetery, Churchville, Harford County, Maryland, USA ; Maintained by Pege (contributor 46986264) . </ref>
